name: VARoleCoachPartnerDismissedAmbitions

custom.system_prompt: Elena is hurt after Marcus called her cookbook photography project 'just a hobby' during an argument. She's tempted to bring up every time she's felt unsupported, but asks Sigma to help her think it through first.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.tts_prompt: Warm, calm, doesn't minimize the hurt

sound_effects_config.prompt: Quiet kitchen, evening, sitting alone with a cold cup of tea

initial_prompt: Generate a scene where Elena is hurt after Marcus dismissively called her cookbook photography project 'just a hobby' during an argument. She wants to bring it up again but is tempted to pile on every past instance of feeling unsupported. She asks Sigma to help her prepare before talking to Marcus. Sigma helps her separate the one comment from the accumulated history, decide what she actually wants to say, and rehearse it. Keep every line short and natural — the opening line already addresses Sigma directly.

variations.context: Solo processing after a partner's dismissive comment about a personal ambition

setting.mood: Hurt, tempted to escalate into a larger grievance
setting.relationship_dynamic: Individual preparing to reengage with her partner, not a live mediation
setting.background: This isn't the first time Elena has felt her creative work treated as less serious than Marcus's career
setting.conversation_style: Short, hurt sentences that become more specific as she talks it through

scenario_template.topic: Elena addresses Sigma directly in her first line, folding the comment and her hurt into the request — e.g. 'Sigma, Marcus just called my cookbook project a hobby. I want to bring up every time this has happened, but I don't know if that's fair.' One short turn, straight to Sigma.
scenario_template.note: The trigger and the ask arrive together.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma asks what Marcus actually said in the moment, versus what pattern Elena feels it's part of, in one or two short questions.
scenario_template.note: This should surface that tonight's comment and the longer pattern are two different, related things.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma asks whether Elena wants to address tonight's comment specifically, or actually wants to raise the bigger pattern — and helps her decide which conversation she's ready to have right now.
scenario_template.note: She should land on addressing tonight's comment first, with the pattern noted as a separate future conversation.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma helps Elena rehearse a specific, concrete way to raise tonight's comment without immediately escalating into the full history. One or two short exchanges.
scenario_template.note: Short, specific line, not a speech about the whole relationship.

scenario_template.topic: Elena reacts, still a little hurt but clearer about what she'll actually say. Keep this realistic — the underlying hurt about being taken seriously doesn't fully resolve here.
scenario_template.mood: Steadier but not fully at ease

variations.context: Discussing a partner's dismissive comment about a podcast project

setting.relationship_dynamic: Individual preparing to reengage with her partner, not a live mediation
setting.background: One of them's podcast idea was dismissed as unrealistic by the other.
setting.conversation_style: Short, hurt sentences that become more specific as she talks it through

scenario_template.topic: One of them directly tells Sigma that the other just brushed off their podcast idea as 'unrealistic,' and they're upset.
scenario_template.note: Sigma should stay neutral and focused.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma asks what the partner said about the podcast specifically, versus the pattern one of them feels of not being supported.
Sigma helps one of them decide whether to address the specific 'unrealistic' comment or the overall pattern of dismissiveness.
Sigma assists in rehearsing a response that calmly addresses the specific incident without broad generalizations.
One of them feels more prepared and clear about addressing the comment, even though the hurt still lingers.
